instructions.record_countess: Travel to the Black Marsh waypoint, start recording there, and move to your preferred combat position near the Countess. Finish recording with {{finish_key}}.
instructions.record_mephisto: Travel to the Durance of Hate Level 2 waypoint, start recording there, and move to your preferred combat position near Mephisto. Finish recording with {{finish_key}}.
instructions.record_summoner: Travel to the Arcane Sanctuary waypoint, start recording there, and move to your preferred combat position near the Summoner. Finish recording with {{finish_key}}.
instructions.record_nihlathak: Travel to the Halls of Pain waypoint, start recording there, and move to your preferred combat position near Nihlathak in the Halls of Vaught. Finish recording with {{finish_key}}.
instructions.record_cow_leg: Travel to the Stony Field waypoint. You do not need to clear it first. Start recording there, enter the already open red portal to Tristram, and move near Wirt's body. Do not click Wirt. Finish recording with {{finish_key}}.
instructions.record_cow_sweep: Open the Cow Level manually and clear it completely before recording. Start recording near the red arrival portal, follow your complete farming loop, and finish at your chosen endpoint with {{finish_key}}.
instructions.record_lower_kurast: Travel to the Lower Kurast waypoint and start recording. Teleport along the rows of huts and find the campfire: two rectangular huts above a fire enclosed by a short wall. The western hut contains two large chests and the eastern hut one. The same huts contain an armor stand and a weapon rack. If you see a second fire with the same layout, record the route to it as well. Do not click the chests or racks yourself. Finish recording near the last group of huts with {{finish_key}}.
